cohort: The study analyzed 64 late-onset FGR patients and 72 controls from an initial cohort of 1016 pregnant individuals who had maternal blood samples collected at 11-14 weeks gestation.
finding: Elevated first trimester gelsolin (GSN) levels were significantly higher in the late-onset FGR group and showed predictive value for late-onset FGR and adverse neonatal outcomes.
cross-section timing: Maternal blood samples collected at 11-14 weeks gestation.
